name: Chuck Berry

whyMatters.en: St. Louis guitarist and songwriter. Chess Records singles from 1955–58 set lasting models for rock’n’roll guitar intros, narrative lyrics, and stage showmanship including the duck walk.
whyMatters.zh: 圣路易斯吉他手与词曲作者。1955–58 年 Chess Records 单曲确立了摇滚吉他前奏、叙事歌词与舞台表演（含鸭步）的长期写法。

note.en: 1955 Chess debut hit; car-chase lyric over a country/R&B hybrid beat.
note.zh: 1955 年 Chess 出道热单；追车叙事歌词，节拍融合乡村与 R&B。

note.en: 1958 Chess single; double-stop guitar intro and lyric about a guitar kid from Louisiana.
note.zh: 1958 年 Chess 单曲；双音吉他前奏，歌词写路易斯安那的吉他少年。

interviewQuotes.text: The guitar is the most important thing.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Chuck Berry

interviewQuotes.text: If you can play the duck walk and the double-stops, you've got the show.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Chuck Berry

lyricQuotes: Hail, hail rock and roll / Deliver me from the days of old

shortBio.en: St. Louis rock’n’roll, Chess Records, 1955–. Maybellene, Roll Over Beethoven, and Johnny B. Goode are the core reference singles.
shortBio.zh: 圣路易斯摇滚，Chess Records，1955 年起。《Maybellene》、《Roll Over Beethoven》与《Johnny B. Goode》是主要参照单曲。

body.en:
Chuck Berry recorded for Chess Records in Chicago from the mid-1950s. Early singles include Maybellene (1955), Roll Over Beethoven (1956), and Johnny B. Goode (1958). The songs combine storytelling verses—cars, youth, and guitar ambition—with clear guitar intros and a strong backbeat. Johnnie Johnson often played piano on the sessions.

British beat groups and later rock bands covered these 45s widely. The double-stop intro to Johnny B. Goode remains one of the most copied guitar openings in rock.
body.zh:
Chuck Berry 自 1950 年代中期起在芝加哥为 Chess Records 录音。早期单曲包括《Maybellene》（1955）、《Roll Over Beethoven》（1956）和《Johnny B. Goode》（1958）。歌曲以叙事主歌（汽车、青年、吉他野心）配合清晰的吉他前奏与明确的后拍。录音中常有 Johnnie Johnson 弹钢琴。

英国 beat 组合与后来的摇滚乐队大量翻唱这些 45 转单曲。《Johnny B. Goode》的双音前奏是摇滚中被模仿最多的吉他开头之一。

body.en:
Berry’s role in early rock’n’roll rests on two linked skills: writing short narrative verses and inventing guitar intros that other players can learn and reuse.

Stage moves such as the duck walk are part of the documented show. The Chess singles remain the primary source for how his writing and playing sound.
body.zh:
Berry 在早期摇滚中的位置建立在两项相关能力上：写短篇叙事主歌，以及写出其他乐手能学会并复用的吉他前奏。

鸭步等舞台动作有表演记录可查。要听他的写法与弹法，仍以 Chess 单曲为第一手来源。

body.en:
Maybellene (1955) was Berry’s breakthrough Chess side. The lyric follows a car chase; the groove sits between country and R&B.

It established him as a writer of verse stories over a danceable rock’n’roll beat, not only as a guitar showman.
body.zh:
《Maybellene》（1955）是 Berry 在 Chess 的突破单曲。歌词写追车；节奏介于乡村与 R&B 之间。

这首歌确立了他作为叙事词曲作者的位置：在可跳舞的摇滚节拍上讲故事，而不只是吉他表演。

body.en:
Johnny B. Goode (1958) opens with a double-stop guitar figure that later guitarists treat as standard practice material.

The lyric follows a Louisiana boy who plays guitar and aims for a larger stage. Chess’s recording keeps the arrangement clear and direct.
body.zh:
《Johnny B. Goode》（1958）以双音吉他乐句开场，后来的吉他手常把它当作基础练习材料。

歌词写一个路易斯安那少年弹吉他、想上更大舞台。Chess 的录音编曲清晰、直接。

title.zh: 英国 beat 组合的翻唱

body.en:
In the early 1960s, UK beat groups often covered Berry before releasing originals. The Beatles and the Rolling Stones both recorded his songs.

What traveled was concrete: lick-based intros, verse storytelling, and a guitar-fronted rock’n’roll band layout.
body.zh:
1960 年代初，英国 beat 组合常在发行原创前翻唱 Berry。《The Beatles》与《The Rolling Stones》都录过他的歌。

被带走的是具体写法：以乐句为基础的前奏、叙事主歌，以及吉他靠前的摇滚乐队编制。

body.en:
In interviews Berry often stresses the guitar and the stage act together: double-stops and the duck walk as practical parts of the show.

The records still come first for hearing how the songs were built.
body.zh:
采访中 Berry 常把吉他与舞台动作放在一起谈：双音与鸭步都是表演的实际组成部分。

要听清歌曲怎么写成，仍以唱片为准。

note.en: Double-stop intro and guitar-kid lyric; a lasting reference for rock guitar openings.
note.zh: 双音前奏与吉他少年歌词；摇滚吉他开头的长期参照。

note.en: Chess-era singles that linked narrative lyrics, guitar intros, and a portable stage act.
note.zh: Chess 时期单曲：叙事歌词、吉他前奏与可复用的舞台动作连在一起。

label.en: Chuck + classic rock and roll band

note.en: Berry on vocals and guitar with Chicago session rhythm; Johnnie Johnson on piano on many Chess dates.
note.zh: Berry 主唱与吉他，配芝加哥录音室节奏段；多场 Chess 录音由 Johnnie Johnson 弹钢琴。
